quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Update on eVOLVE-Lung02 Phase III trial of volrustomig plus (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AstraZeneca is discontinuing the eVOLVE-Lung02 Phase III trial of volrustomig (a PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody, 750mg intravenous) plus chemotherapy versus pembrolizumab (200mg) plus chemotherapy as 1st-line treatment of metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 expression <50%, after the Independent Data Monitoring Committee concluded at a planned review that the volrustomig combination was unlikely to meet either dual primary endpoint (PFS or OS) in the primary analysis population of PD-L1 negative tumours (<1%). The trial had enrolled 895 patients across 25 countries; no new safety signals were identified. The other Phase III volrustomig trials continue as planned in cervical cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and mesothelioma.
quarterly_data.figure: eVOLVE-Lung02 discontinued (futility on both dual primary endpoints, PD-L1 <1%); 895 patients, 25 countries
